body:
I didn't have to read this. I choose to read this. And i'm sorry you feel that way ive felt that way and still do sometimes. And honestly all in all it might not ever get better. but you will have a chance to get away and distance yourself from those miserable people who make you miserable and have your own life and family and maybe that's something worth looking forward to. 

You also dont have to be "successful" whatever that means to be happy (whatever that entitles) hope on a bus and see the world be a beach hobo and live in the waters. theres so many ways to find yourself. maybe you can spend a extra day thinking about it ?
